title: When the Current Sings
author: Vesper Almeida
blurb: Jude Okafor, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
